description: A JUnit test class for the ModifyColumnGenerator component in a Liquibase extension, testing SQL generation, database-specific behavior, validation, and support for extra metadata.

classes.name: ModifyColumnGeneratorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for Verify behaviors of ModifyColumnGenerator in generating SQL and handling database-specific logic.

methods.name: shouldGenerateSql
methods.description: Test that the generator creates the correct SQL statement for modifying a column.

methods.name: shouldGetDefaultClause
methods.description: Test the getDefaultClause method across different databases.

methods.name: shouldGetModifyString
methods.description: Verify the correct modify string (e.g., 'ALTER COLUMN', 'MODIFY') for various databases.

methods.name: shouldGetPostDataTypeString
methods.description: Check suffix string after data type definitions for different databases.

methods.name: shouldGetPreDataTypeString
methods.description: Check prefix string before data type definitions for different databases.

methods.name: shouldRejectMissingTableNameAndEmptyColumns
methods.description: Test validation errors when required info is missing.

methods.name: shouldRejectAddingAPrimaryKeyColumnToH2Database
methods.description: Test validation message when attempting to add primary key columns on specific databases.

methods.name: shouldSupportExtraMetaData
methods.description: Test whether the generator correctly identifies support for extra metadata on various databases.
